This deposit accompanies “Raw-Fragment Benchmarking for Redundancy Tests in Quantum Darwinism and Spectrum Broadcast Structure,” a paper built around a practical but often hidden problem in tests of quantum objectivity. Aggregate mutual-information curves can show that information grows with fragment size, but they do not reveal whether independent fragments really carry accessible, mutually consistent records of the same pointer variable.
